meta.name: caveman
meta.description: Ultra-compressed communication mode. Cuts output tokens 65% (measured) by speaking like caveman while keeping full technical accuracy. Supports intensity levels: lite, full (default), ultra, wenyan-lite, wenyan-full, wenyan-ultra. Use when user says "caveman mode", "talk like caveman", "use caveman", "less tokens", "be brief", or invokes /caveman. Also auto-triggers when token efficiency is requested.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用原始人语气压缩 AI 回复,最高省 65% 输出量
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望 AI 回复更简短、更省 token
copy.tagline_en: Speak caveman to slash token output by up to 65%.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want terse AI responses and lower token usage.

howto.what: Claude 回复变极简原始人风格:删寒暄、填充词、废话,保留全部技术细节;代码、术语、数字不变,输出 token 可减约 65%。默认 full 强度,支持 ultra 与文言文模式;风格持续到你说“stop caveman”才恢复。
howto.when: 当你说「caveman mode」「be brief」「less tokens」等关键词,或要求 token 更省、回复更短时触发;调用 /caveman 命令也会开启。

say.note: 开启默认 full 强度的原始人回复。
切换到 ultra 超极简档。

howto.what_en: Terse caveman-like replies: fluff, filler, pleasantries dropped; all technical detail, code, terms, numbers kept. Output tokens ~65% less. Default 'full' intensity; lite/ultra/wenyan variants. Mode persists until 'stop caveman' or 'normal mode'.
howto.when_en: Triggers when user says 'caveman mode', 'talk like caveman', 'less tokens', 'be brief', or invokes '/caveman'; also auto-triggers when token efficiency is requested.

say_en.note: Starts caveman-style terse replies at default full intensity.
